description: Write DataFrame rows as entities to Azure Table Storage. NoSQL key-value store, way cheaper than Cosmos for simple structured data ($0.045/GB/mo + $0.00036 per 10K transactions).

account_name_env_var.description: Env var holding the storage account name
account_name_env_var.label: Account Name Env Var

account_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the account key. Omit to use DefaultAzureCredential (Entra OAuth).
account_key_env_var.label: Account Key Env Var

partition_key_column.description: DataFrame column that maps to PartitionKey on each entity
partition_key_column.label: Partition Key Column

row_key_column.description: DataFrame column that maps to RowKey on each entity (unique within partition)
row_key_column.label: Row Key Column

create_if_missing.description: Create the table if it doesn't exist (free metadata operation)
create_if_missing.label: Create If Missing

write_mode.description: 'upsert' (replace existing entity), 'merge' (patch existing), or 'insert' (fail on dup)
write_mode.label: Write Mode

batch_size.description: Max entities per batch. Azure caps at 100 entities per transaction; all entities in a batch must share the same PartitionKey.
batch_size.label: Batch Size

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds
